PANKAJ AMILKANTHWAR

Pune/Mumbai, India | +91-9860082513 | pankaj.amilkanthwar@gmail.com LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pankaj-amilkanthwar-598787232/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Highly accomplished Capital Markets professional with 16 years of total experience, including 13+ years specializing in Investment Banking, Middle Office Operations, and Trade Lifecycle Management. Proven track record of evolving from core operations into leadership and transformation roles, successfully managing team sizes up to 20 members. Expert in end-to-end trade execution, confirmations, settlements, and reconciliation for complex treasury products including FX, Fixed Income (Bonds), and Derivatives. Adept at driving process improvements, automation initiatives, front-to-back coordination, and operational risk mitigation. Possesses strong stakeholder governance, RAID management capabilities, and transition experience, making them uniquely positioned for Markets Treasury PM/BA delivery.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Treasury Products & Markets: FX Cash & Options, Fixed Income (Bonds), OTC Derivatives, Loans & Deposits. • Trade Lifecycle Management: Trade Affirmation & Matching, Clearing, Settlement, Cash & Position Reconciliation, Investigation & Exception Handling.

Project & Change Management: Process Migration & Transition, Automation Initiatives, RAID Log Governance,



Business Process Re-engineering. Stakeholder Governance: Front-to-Back Liaison (Traders, Counterparties, Custodians, Brokers, Senior Management).

Tools & Frameworks: SWIFT Messaging, DTCC, Omgeo, MS Office Suite, Escalation & Risk Control Frameworks.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

STATE STREET | MUMBAI Manager – Middle Office (Derivatives Operations & Change)

Jan 2024 – 7th June 2026.

Operational Delivery: Lead and manage a 6-member team responsible for end-to-end OTC Derivatives trade



confirmations and settlements, ensuring strict adherence to global market deadlines. Stakeholder & Front-to-Back Governance: Coordinate directly with traders, institutional counterparties, global custodians, and internal business lines to resolve high-value confirmation and settlement breaks.

Process Transformation: Championed and implemented key process improvements and automation initiatives

that significantly reduced manual processing touchpoints and optimized operational workflows.

Risk & Control Management: Redesigned and strengthened the operational escalation framework for time-

sensitive trades, lowering overall operational risk exposure and ensuring business continuity.

STATE STREET SYNTEL PVT LTD | PUNE Deputy Manager – Middle Office (Equity & Fixed Income)

Jul 2022 – Dec 2023

Team Leadership: Supervised a large-scale, 20-member team handling global equity and fixed income (Bonds)

post-trade operations and settlements.

Trade Lifecycle Optimization: Oversaw matching, affirmation, and discrepancy resolution processes utilizing

global networks like DTCC, Omgeo, and SWIFT to legally bind trades.

Reconciliations & Data Integrity: Managed daily cash, stock, and position reconciliation workflows, resolving

mismatches between internal accounting books and external custodian records.

Change & SLA Tracking: Spearheaded continuous improvement projects to reduce manual effort; monitored and



improved team productivity metrics and SLA adherence. Ecosystem Integration: Strengthened operational integration and communication flows across Front Office, Custodians, and Clearing Brokers to mitigate settlement risk before market cut-offs.

BA CONTINUUM INDIA PVT LTD (BANK OF AMERICA MERRILL LYNCH) | PUNE Team Leader – Trade Settlements (Fixed Income)

Jun 2017 – Jul 2022

Delivery Management: Governed daily settlement operations for global Fixed Income products, ensuring strict



adherence to fund and custody deadlines across multiple geographies. Front-to-Back Liaison: Provided critical middle-office support by liaising between the Front Office (Clients), Back Office, and external Brokers to drive prompt issue resolution and escalation management.

Business Analysis & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conducted deep-dive root cause analysis on structural trade

breaks to isolate workflow gaps and implement preventive measures.

Process Efficiency & Automation: Evaluated operational delivery loops to identify gaps; designed and executed



targeted automation workflows to improve Turnaround Time (TAT) and operational efficiency. Senior Stakeholder Reporting: Prepared, analyzed, and presented operational risk metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and ad-hoc governance reports to senior management on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

ECLERX SERVICES PVT LTD | MUMBAI Senior Analyst – FX & Options

Feb 2015 – Jun 2017

Treasury Lifecycle Management: Managed trade processing, post-settlement activities, and lifecycle



management for FX Cash and Options, ensuring market cut-off compliance. Escalation Management: Owned client escalations end-to-end, partnering with cross-functional technology and operations groups to deliver timely structural fixes.

Continuous Improvement: Contributed to multiple process automation and optimization initiatives, successfully

eliminating manual operational steps.

STATE STREET BANK SYNTEL SERVICES LTD | PUNE Senior Analyst – Core Trade Settlements & Confirmations

Jan 2013 – Nov 2014



Executed middle office operations for Equity and Bond trade confirmations and core settlements across global markets, partnering front-to-back to clear transaction breaks.

SANGAMESHWAR ENGG LTD | PUNE Accounts & Liquidity Officer

Dec 2009 – Dec 2012

Managed accounting finalization, tax compliances, statutory filings, audit coordination, and cash flow/liquidity

tracking.

EDUCATION

MBA in Finance | MITCON Institute of Management, Pune (2008 – 2010)

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
STATE STREET | MUMBAI Manager – Middle Office (Derivatives Operations & Change)
Jan 2024 – 7th June 2026.
Operational Delivery: Lead and manage a 6-member team responsible for end-to-end OTC Derivatives trade

confirmations and settlements, ensuring strict adherence to global market deadlines. Stakeholder & Front-to-Back Governance: Coordinate directly with traders, institutional counterparties, global custodians, and internal business lines to resolve high-value confirmation and settlement breaks.
Process Transformation: Championed and implemented key process improvements and automation initiatives
that significantly reduced manual processing touchpoints and optimized operational workflows.
Risk & Control Management: Redesigned and strengthened the operational escalation framework for time-
sensitive trades, lowering overall operational risk exposure and ensuring business continuity.
STATE STREET SYNTEL PVT LTD | PUNE Deputy Manager – Middle Office (Equity & Fixed Income)
Jul 2022 – Dec 2023
Team Leadership: Supervised a large-scale, 20-member team handling global equity and fixed income (Bonds)
post-trade operations and settlements.
Trade Lifecycle Optimization: Oversaw matching, affirmation, and discrepancy resolution processes utilizing
global networks like DTCC, Omgeo, and SWIFT to legally bind trades.
Reconciliations & Data Integrity: Managed daily cash, stock, and position reconciliation workflows, resolving
mismatches between internal accounting books and external custodian records.
Change & SLA Tracking: Spearheaded continuous improvement projects to reduce manual effort; monitored and

improved team productivity metrics and SLA adherence. Ecosystem Integration: Strengthened operational integration and communication flows across Front Office, Custodians, and Clearing Brokers to mitigate settlement risk before market cut-offs.
BA CONTINUUM INDIA PVT LTD (BANK OF AMERICA MERRILL LYNCH) | PUNE Team Leader – Trade Settlements (Fixed Income)
Jun 2017 – Jul 2022
Delivery Management: Governed daily settlement operations for global Fixed Income products, ensuring strict

adherence to fund and custody deadlines across multiple geographies. Front-to-Back Liaison: Provided critical middle-office support by liaising between the Front Office (Clients), Back Office, and external Brokers to drive prompt issue resolution and escalation management.
Business Analysis & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conducted deep-dive root cause analysis on structural trade
breaks to isolate workflow gaps and implement preventive measures.
Process Efficiency & Automation: Evaluated operational delivery loops to identify gaps; designed and executed

targeted automation workflows to improve Turnaround Time (TAT) and operational efficiency. Senior Stakeholder Reporting: Prepared, analyzed, and presented operational risk metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and ad-hoc governance reports to senior management on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
ECLERX SERVICES PVT LTD | MUMBAI Senior Analyst – FX & Options
Feb 2015 – Jun 2017
Treasury Lifecycle Management: Managed trade processing, post-settlement activities, and lifecycle

management for FX Cash and Options, ensuring market cut-off compliance. Escalation Management: Owned client escalations end-to-end, partnering with cross-functional technology and operations groups to deliver timely structural fixes.
Continuous Improvement: Contributed to multiple process automation and optimization initiatives, successfully
eliminating manual operational steps.
STATE STREET BANK SYNTEL SERVICES LTD | PUNE Senior Analyst – Core Trade Settlements & Confirmations
Jan 2013 – Nov 2014

Executed middle office operations for Equity and Bond trade confirmations and core settlements across global markets, partnering front-to-back to clear transaction breaks.
SANGAMESHWAR ENGG LTD | PUNE Accounts & Liquidity Officer
Dec 2009 – Dec 2012
Managed accounting finalization, tax compliances, statutory filings, audit coordination, and cash flow/liquidity
tracking.
